text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Grey dots: a random sample of 400 of the about 1,200 forecast cases in each panel, each averaged over 3 seeds. Orange line: mean of all the panel's cases in bins of 0.1 clear-sky index. Above 0 the shift lowered the forecast too far. Five Primary substations, June to August, valid 09:00 to 15:00 UTC, 1 to 4 days ahead, forecasts from experiment 46.'
